title: Digital Marketing Client Brief Questionnaire
intro: Thank you for taking the time to complete this brief. The information below will help us understand your business, objectives, target audience, priorities, and expectations so we can develop the most relevant digital marketing strategy and media plan.
Please provide as much information as possible. If a question is not applicable, you may leave it blank or mark it as N/A.
